description: Cogitate (2025): no sustained content-specific synchronization was found within posterior cortex between category-selective areas and V1/V2, the preregistered IIT prediction, with Bayesian support for the null for gamma-band synchrony.
limitations: One adversarial study of visual consciousness with suprathreshold faces, objects, letters and false fonts. Tests only the predictions both teams preregistered. Limited iEEG sampling of V1/V2.

sources.quote: For IIT, the lack of sustained synchronization within posterior cortex represents the most direct challenge, based on our preregistration.
For IIT, a lack of sustained synchronization within the posterior cortex contradicts the claim that network connectivity specifies consciousness.
